text:
alyssa_pm: Lightweight check-in: GA checklist for Edge-Optimized — Legal needs SLA wording, Finance needs pricing examples for AE, Docs needs final API snippets, SRE needs alert thresholds and a short rollback play. Can owners confirm windows and blockers?

vince_eng: Ill validate autoscale and cold-start mitigations. Confirming SLOs: p50 40ms / p95 140ms for <=1KB. Use 5m rolling for alerts, 1h for SLA calc.

maria_fin: I'll put together three invoice examples (Pilot, Pro, Enterprise) showing Reserved vs Burst. Need expected avg tokens/request and expected concurrency per tier. If you drop numbers here I'll model.

hana_docs: Docs will ship quickstart + migration note once SLA text is stable. I need final Node/Python snippets and a tiny error-handling example for customers.

leo_sre: Alert levels proposal: warning p95>120ms, page p95>200ms for 10m, page if error rate>0.8% for 5m. Runbook must include: who pages, comms template, traffic-shed threshold. Short rollback play: shift traffic to fallback model or region, scale down model size.

legal-bot: Heads up: any service-credit language must include definitions for "normal operating conditions", measurement method, and maintenance windows. Legal review required before publishing.

alyssa_pm: Owners, consolidated: SLA wording -> maria_fin + legal (48h), Pricing/invoices -> maria_fin (24h), Docs quickstart + snippets -> hana_docs (48h), Monitoring/dashboard + runbook -> leo_sre (48h), Autoscale validation -> vince_eng (48h). Shiproom tentatively Thu 09:00 PT.

vince_eng: Risk note: long-decode models showed increased p99 when batching hit N=32. Mitigation: reduce max batch depth on edge pools; enable prefix cache. I'll run a focused soak tonight and post numbers.

maria_fin: Draft SLA blurb for docs: "Redwood Edge-Optimized targets p95 latency <= 140ms for requests <=1KB during normal operating conditions; eligible contracts may include service credits for material breaches." Will send a PDF with invoice examples and a simple credit-table.

hana_docs: Good starter. I'll put the exact wording in a docs PR for legal to review (will link here). Also adding a small: "What to expect at GA" note.

leo_sre: Runbook snippet (to paste into handbook):
```
- Warning: p95 > 120ms for 5m -> Slack alert to #edge-monitoring (no page)
- Page: p95 > 200ms for 10m OR error rate > 0.8% for 5m -> page infra-oncall + incident cmd
- If GPU util > 90% and queue growth > 1000 -> trigger emergency-burst scale and consider traffic-shed
- Rollback: shift traffic to baseline model variant in region-us-east-1; notify sales/CS
```

deploy-bot: Canary: edge-ga pipeline #612 passed; canary traffic @6% in us-east, no regressions observed.

alyssa_pm: Please post PR links and invoice mockups in-thread by EOD tomorrow so we can do quick legal review. If any owner is blocked, flag now. React with :thumbsup: if youre good for the timeline.

maria_fin: :thumbsup:

hana_docs: :thumbsup:

vince_eng: :thumbsup:

leo_sre: :thumbsup:

alyssa_pm: Thanks everyone. I'll compile a final checklist and drop into the shiproom agenda when links appear.
